newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan exchange says to list grain index futures.
newsitem.headline: Japan exchange says to list grain index futures.

text.p: The Kansai Commodity Exchange said on Friday it would launch a grain index futures contract by the end of this year as a price risk hedging tool for the domestic grain industry.
The Commodity Trading Council, an advisory body to the trade and agriculture ministers, on Thursday approved a request by the exchange to list the grain index futures.
"Following the approval (by the council), we'd like to start trading the grain index by the end of this year," said an official of the Kansai Commodity Exchange, which is located in Osaka.
The index futures will be traded on the automated trading system, he said. The exchange currently trades yen-based futures contracts of red beans, soybeans, raw sugar and silk.
